structured_output.scope: pilot-workflows (source-only review of supplied files: scripts/workflow_boundary.py, scripts/check_pilot_publication.py, six model workflows, check.yml, results-validate.yml, tests/test_workflow_boundary.py, docs/isles-pilot/OPERATING_MODEL_20260905.md; scout.py/orchestrator/job store not supplied, no tests executed)
findings: PRIVACY (blocking): check_pilot_publication.py denies the substring '/results/' but the repo's actual bundle directories are named 'results_v2' (results-validate.yml derives probes/$IDEA/results_v2). A raw results bundle under an allowed prefix, e.g. campaigns/isles24-pilot/.../results_v2/*.json or tests/results_v2/*.jsonl, passes the path filter and the size/NUL/credential heuristics. Match deny rules per path component (results*, staged, .private*) instead of slash-delimited substrings.

CORRECTNESS (blocking): workflow_boundary.publish pins the remote via ls-remote and then runs a plain 'git push' — a TOCTOU window where a remote rewind to an ancestor of source still fast-forwards despite the remote no longer equaling expected_remote; ls-remote tail-matching also lets a ref like refs/heads/refs/heads/<dest> satisfy the pin. Use git push --force-with-lease=refs/heads/<dest>:<expected_remote> for an atomic compare-and-swap (still fast-forward-only given the ancestry check).

AUTHORITY (fix before unblocking): the 'Verify explicit pilot execution boundary' step runs workflow_boundary.py from the source_sha checkout itself — self-attestation; no trusted-side code binds source_sha to reviewed pilot history. Moot only because the unconditional 'Campaign route required' exit-1 precedes all secret use; add a trusted ancestry check (source_sha reachable from the dispatched pilot ref) before that block is ever lifted.

SECURITY (latent): inputs.idea (interpret/confer/idea-pipeline), inputs.candidate, inputs.charter, inputs.top_n, and inputs.tracks are interpolated via ${{ }} directly into run: shell scripts — script-injection anti-pattern; confer's CONFER_QUESTION env-var pattern is correct and should be applied everywhere. Currently unreachable behind the campaign-route block.

results-validate.yml: the guard github.ref != pilot-branch is vacuous (results/** pushes can never equal that ref); the main checkout omits persist-credentials: false unlike every other hardened checkout while the job (pull-requests: write) processes an untrusted data branch; and the documented 'never invoke for campaign' disposition has no technical control.

TEST GAP: test_every_model_workflow_fails_closed asserts the 'Campaign route required' step exists and precedes 'Install agent CLIs' but never asserts it fails; a no-op refactor of the guard passes the suite. Assert the step body contains 'exit 1'.

HYGIENE: scout-cycle.yml keeps a nightly schedule trigger that can only produce skipped runs, and its header comment ('Every completed stage is committed and pushed') contradicts the no-push disposition; the always-blocked workflows request contents: write (actioner also pull-requests: write) they cannot legitimately use — reduce to contents: read while blocked.

HYGIENE: publish() mutates the module global check_pilot_publication.ROOT to retarget the audit (fragile, not thread-safe; pass root as a parameter), and the returned receipt omits destination and expected_remote, so the persistent artifact does not record the remote-before pin it enforced.

POSITIVE: fail-closed properties verified in source — guard precedes CLI/secret steps in all six model workflows with persist-credentials: false; contaminated-ancestry check requires returncode exactly 1 so git errors also block; no force/rebase paths; merges, dirty trees, binaries, notebook outputs, and credential-like bytes all raise; the idea-023 missing approval marker is left visible rather than concealed, preserving scientific-approval integrity.
